title: Store parsers: additional stores
lead: Implement parsers for any other stores the deployment uses, one module each, following the first-store pattern.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** stores without item-level detail in their emails (park them).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Occasional orders from other stores would otherwise be invisible to the pantry.

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body: 1. Which additional stores, in priority order? Is each one used often enough to be worth a parser? (Split into one slice per store with `slicer add --discovered-from` if useful.)

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: 1. For each chosen store: add redacted samples, write the parser, register it in config.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - Tests pass on each store's redacted samples.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when the owner asks; no AI attribution.
